purpose: Diagnose context-dependent representation geometry on fully known public teacher-prefix pairs before proposing another no-fit decoder.

runtime.qualification: qualify longest declared C6_repeat_13_length_3 public short cell with all eight endpoints by batched-vs-single exact equality before retaining the batched path; no target model or private truth

tokens.source: fixed public token IDs declared before the diagnostic; all labels are teacher-prefix controls

contexts.role: baseline prototype context b_v = z([BOS],v); endpoint position 1

panel.endpoint_definition: z(C,v) is the public prefix last hidden state for C+[v]

checks.cache: full forward, one-block cached, and one-token incremental cached outputs are compared for every context and declared endpoint; cloned reference probes must not mutate the persistent cache
checks.reference: probe r=220 after each known C; cloned-cache output is compared with full C+[r]
checks.sign: q_minus = z(C,v) - (z(C,r)-b_r) is the P01 subtraction rule; q_plus is an explicit opposite-sign wiring control
checks.position: position indices are recorded from context lengths; same-length controls are endpoint-position matched, while repeated-13 rows are explicitly context-length/relative-position controls and never position-only
checks.table_recompute: P02 recomputes b_v at eight intra-op threads and reports max difference against reused P01 table rows; no bitwise equivalence is assumed

shared_offset.mean_offset: mean_v delta(C,v) for C1..C4; C0 is retained as the explicit zero baseline but excluded from C1..C4 decision aggregates; public teacher-prefix oracle/public-panel centering diagnostic only
shared_offset.pair_deformation: [z(C,v)-z(C,w)] - [z(C0,v)-z(C0,w)] for C1..C4; C0 rows are retained only as the explicit zero baseline
shared_offset.local_dictionary: restricted-dictionary control: fixed N=9 entries for each candidate ID, the ID itself plus eight nearest other reused P01 BOS prototypes (N8-other), with deterministic token-ID ties; rank every primary query within its declared local dictionary
shared_offset.targeted_full_vocab_rows: exactly 12 primary rows: each of C1..C4 with endpoint IDs {220,4096,2048}; raw, mean-centered oracle, and reference-corrected variants use the same public dictionary
shared_offset.restriction: no full table is rebuilt and no per-context projected table is materialized; full-vocabulary scans are limited to the predeclared 12 endpoint rows

lens.role: frozen fitted-lens diagnostic control; never a fitting-free method
comparisons: original frozen historical A1 g(h) against the raw public input-embedding dictionary
same-token cross-context variation and different-token separation in raw and projected geometry for the C1-C4 equal-endpoint-position panel, with any C0-inclusive summary labelled separately
same 12 targeted rows and same public dictionary for raw/projection/A1 ranking comparisons

assets.prototype_construction: public_prefix([BOS,v])[1] from P01 publication head e3e8a1de020598fb68c1ed8b64c0e155823817f5

stopping_rule.advance_only_if: a deterministic context correction is supported by small residual-to-delta ratios and improves true-token ranking margins in the public-panel oracle diagnostic
stopping_rule.stop_if: offset residuals remain token-dependent or centered/reference corrections do not improve margins; this task then deprioritizes the dictionary family and supplies diagnostics to the learned-decoder workstream
